facility_roles.quote: The initial experiments operating at the 4 collision regions of PETRA were the JADE [28], Mark-J [29], PLUTO [31] and TASSO [30] detectors.

summary.plain: A detector that first recorded e+e- collisions at DESY's DORIS ring from 1974 and then moved to the PETRA collider in 1978, where it contributed to the 1979 gluon evidence. CELLO replaced it at PETRA in 1980.
summary.technical: PLUTO: detector at DORIS from end of 1974 (with DASP) and at PETRA from October 1978 (data from January 1979) until replaced by CELLO in March 1980; PLUTO's DORIS data on the Upsilon (9.46 GeV) showed event shapes different from the continuum, suggestive of three-gluon decay (Courier).
